name: pae-software
description: Plataforma de apoyo academico para estudiantes y docentes

scripts.test: npm run test:content:core && npm run test:learning && npm run test:ops && npm run test:frontend && node --test tests/architecture/eventContracts.test.cjs
scripts.test:content:core: npm --prefix backend/services/content-service exec jest src/tests/unit src/tests/integration --runInBand
scripts.test:m8: node --import ./tests/unit-environment.mjs --test tests/m8/platformPreferences.test.cjs tests/m8/notificationTransport.test.cjs tests/m8/backupRestore.test.cjs tests/m8/accessibilityAudit.test.cjs tests/m8/infrastructureSecurity.test.cjs
scripts.qa:coverage: node scripts/qa-coverage.mjs && c8 report --all --include "backend/services/**/src/**/*.js" --include "backend/services/**/scripts/**/*.js" --exclude "**/tests/**" --exclude "**/*.test.js" --reporter=lcov --reporter=json-summary --reporter=text-summary --temp-directory coverage/qa-v8 --reports-dir coverage/qa
